subject.title: feat(clients): provider-grouped model picker with fast, verbosity, and inherited-thinking controls

question: Which capability contract should native Fast mode use: the existing web provider/model support predicate, or a new gateway-advertised capability shared by all clients?
rationale: The gateway currently validates only value shape, while the native branch intentionally shows Fast universally; choosing the durable cross-client capability boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Mirror the existing web support predicate
options.body: Gate the native control with the established web provider/model support behavior and cover supported versus unsupported choices.

options.title: Introduce a gateway capability
options.body: Extend the session/model contract so every client can render Fast only when the gateway advertises support.

options.title: Keep universal Fast
options.body: Intentionally allow no-op overrides for unsupported providers and document that behavior.

recommendation.title: Mirror the existing web support predicate
recommendation.body: Gate the native control with the established web provider/model support behavior and cover supported versus unsupported choices.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows direct ownership of the native-chat parity surface and its shared Swift implementation.
